transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, your Signal Officer. We've got our routine daily communications planning huddle, so let's hear from each of you on your current requirements. Operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield reps -- please report what you need for tomorrow's coordination. Once I have everyone's input, I'll publish the binding communications configuration. The signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today, so we have time, but let's not delay. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Before we finalize the configuration, I need to flag a change. The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow for a scheduled synchronization period. I received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated to reflect this. We'll need to account for this in today's published configuration.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a logistics constraint. I confirmed from the issued-battery ledger that only R3 has enough battery capacity to support the logistics yard tomorrow, and it must be configured at low power from 0700 to 1100. The ledger reconciliation is still awaiting posting to the signal work queue, so this may not yet be visible to the signal shop. We need to account for this low-power requirement on R3 when publishing the configuration.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance constraint. My maintenance test found that R1 must be taken offline for firmware validation from 1200 to 1400 tomorrow, so clinic support during that period must use R2. This test result is still on my technician worksheet and hasn't been entered into the network status board yet, so it may not be visible to the rest of the signal shop. We need to account for R1 being offline during that window when publishing the configuration.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an airfield constraint. I confirmed that airfield calibration activity will make C4 unavailable at the airfield tomorrow, so airfield services must use C3 at 25 watts and complete an interference check before 0800. The airfield notice was signed after the last signal update and has not been added to the configuration packet, so this may not yet be visible to the signal shop. We need to account for C4 being unavailable at the airfield and airfield services moving to C3 at 25 watts when publishing the configuration.
transcript.speaker: A5
